subject: Robert Pattinson as James Bond
title: Robert Pattinson James Bond: Is he the new 007? Yes, it's official
answer: Yes. On Monday, Nov. 16, 2026, Amazon MGM Studios announced that Robert Pattinson, 40, will play James Bond in the next 007 film, directed by Denis Villeneuve from a script by Steven Knight. He becomes the seventh actor to take the role in the official film series, after Daniel Craig.
in_the_news: It is the first Bond casting since Amazon MGM took creative control of the franchise from longtime producers Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson in 2025, and it ends a search that began publicly in May.
body:
Amazon MGM confirmed the news on 007.com. Pattinson called the part "the honour of a lifetime," and Villeneuve said he was "overjoyed" to welcome him. The film, known for now as Bond 26, is produced by Amy Pascal and David Heyman, with Tanya Lapointe as executive producer. Pattinson and Villeneuve already know each other's working habits: the actor appears in Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, which opens Dec. 18.

Pattinson, born in London in 1986, broke out as Cedric Diggory in Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire and became a star with the Twilight films before turning to smaller, director-driven projects. He played the title role in The Batman (2022) and, according to Amazon, is currently shooting The Batman Part II, so the two franchises will have to share his calendar. Earlier in November, trade reports named him and Nicholas Hoult among the actors in final screen tests.

How Bond 26 got here, step by step: On Feb. 20, 2025, Amazon MGM and Eon announced the deal that handed over creative control; producers Pascal and Heyman were named on March 25, 2025. Villeneuve signed on to direct on June 25, 2025, and Steven Knight, creator of Peaky Blinders, was confirmed as writer on July 31, 2025. Amazon MGM said on May 14, 2026, that the hunt for a new 007 was underway, and in September Knight indicated he had finished a first draft. The Nov. 16 announcement closes that loop. For scale: Daniel Craig's casting was revealed in October 2005, and his first film, Casino Royale, arrived 13 months later.

No release date or filming start has been announced. Fan site The James Bond Dossier, which tracks the production, lists 2028 as the likely release year and says shooting could begin in 2027, but the studio has confirmed neither. The title, the cast around Bond and the villain are also still unannounced.

faq.q: When will Robert Pattinson's first Bond movie come out?
faq.a: No date has been set. Industry reports point to 2028, and the studio has not announced when filming starts.

faq.q: Who played James Bond before Pattinson?
faq.a: Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan and Daniel Craig, whose last outing was No Time to Die (2021).
Yes. Amazon says he is currently filming The Batman Part II, a separate Warner Bros. project.

faq.q: Who is making the new Bond film?
faq.a: Amazon MGM Studios, with director Denis Villeneuve, writer Steven Knight and producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman.
